description: Prices one residential house cleaning visit with the math behind EosLog's free cleaning price calculator: time on site from the home's size and square footage, times a frequency factor and the cleaner's hourly rate, plus supplies, drive and add-ons, adjusted for the local market and rounded to $5. Returns the price, a low to high range, hours on site, a per square foot cross-check, the math, and a link that opens the calculator with these inputs so the user can adjust them. Every input is optional and has the calculator's default.

addons.description: Extras that apply: pets (+$15), kids under 10 (+$20), oven inside (+$35), fridge inside (+$30), trash takeout (+$10), laundry, one load washed and folded (+$20).

frequency.description: How often the home is cleaned. deep is a first or one-time deep clean; moveout is a one-time move-out clean.

hourly_rate.description: What the cleaner bills per cleaner-hour, in US dollars.

market.description: rural (0.80x), standard for most US metros (1.00x), or coastal for a high-cost coastal metro (1.30x).

size.description: Bedrooms and bathrooms, for example 3br2ba for 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.

sqft.description: Square footage. Defaults to the typical size for the layout (1,600 for 3br2ba).

name: estimate_house_cleaning_price
title: Estimate a house cleaning price
